g.text: Grocery generation: selected classes and relationships
Solid arrows represent stored references; dashed arrows represent dependencies or realization.
groceryList abbreviates Optional<List<GroceryItem>>: absent and present-empty are distinct states.
Lists may share objects; plain associations do not imply exclusive ownership.
Normal generation supplies 1-7 days with three distinct recipes per day; model constructors are less restrictive.
RecipeBook is an execution parameter, not a stored GenerateListCommand reference.
Only relevant members are shown. Generation requests, viewing, and dietary repair are omitted.
